entries.evidence_type: First-person commentary hosted by the investment firm
entries.review_method: Direct open and review of specific first-person passages
entries.supported_claim: Romick attributes his investment evolution to continuous learning and discusses avoiding major mistakes while acknowledging luck.
entries.limit: Supports only the stated source-level idea; institutional strategies, leverage, returns and personal suitability are not approved.
entries.coach_use: Only this narrow attribution may ground an educational explanation; product application is our synthesis. No fund recommendation or performance promise.
entries.evidence_locator: PDF page 3, paragraphs beginning Thinking about Crescent and Continuous learning; page 5 acknowledges luck.
entries.product_application: Encourage learning and reviewing assumptions; separate preparation from guaranteed financial outcomes.
